svg.title: Neti website assistant architecture
svg.desc: WordPress sends chat requests to API Gateway and Lambda. Lambda uses DynamoDB for session and usage state, Bedrock Knowledge Bases to retrieve approved S3 content indexed with S3 Vectors, and Bedrock to generate answers with guardrails. Reviewed, consented inquiries take a separate website path.
svg.text: Network Experts deployment • Grounded answers and consented contact
Routes the inquiry to the team
Conceptual deployment view. Service artwork from the official AWS Architecture Icons package.
